_comment: Branding merged into the product.json of a VS Code source build.
Only keys listed here are touched; everything else keeps the upstream value.
Anything compiled into the executable (taskbar icon, file descriptions) needs
the resource patch step, not this file.
_installer_identity_comment: Installer identity. The architecture-specific ids are deliberately distinct:
sharing one GUID between x64 and arm64 tells Windows that two different
products are the same one, which breaks side-by-side installs and upgrades.
win32AppId is not present in the current sources and is not invented here.
_microsoft_remnants_comment: The sources still name Microsoft services in several places. They are
overridden rather than left alone: a product that calls a vendor endpoint
the user never chose is exactly the kind of surprise this build exists to
_gallery_comment: The sources ship no gallery at all: the Microsoft marketplace is added only
in their proprietary build. Open VSX is the open alternative, and pointing
at it is a choice we make rather than a default we inherit.
